scope: TEAL prototype only; does not approve entries in the existing Human Literacy catalog

claims.claim: FAO estimates 645 million faced hunger in 2025.
claims.limit: Estimate of dietary-energy insufficiency, not the broader food-insecurity indicator or a live count.

claims.claim: Recent global hunger decline is uneven; protection and food-system investment are relevant.
claims.limit: Policy discussion and report trends, not a causal estimate of TEAL impact.

claims.claim: Cash assistance is used where markets can supply food but affordability is a barrier.
claims.limit: Not universally superior to food delivery; supply, price, safety and implementation matter.

claims.claim: 4.6 billion were not fully covered by essential health services in 2023; coverage improved since 2000.
claims.limit: Not fully covered is not no healthcare. Revised 2025 indicator framework; do not mix older report series unqualified.

claims.claim: Strong primary care is an important route toward access.
claims.limit: Requires workforce, medicines, funding and quality; no individualized recommendation or projected-lives-saved claim.

claims.claim: UNESCO reports 273 million children and youth out of school in 2024; completion has improved since 2000.
claims.limit: Undercounts some conflict-affected children; access/completion/learning are distinct. Do not present as 2026 headcount.

claims.claim: Teaching support and instruction matched to current skill are evidence-supported approaches.
claims.limit: Evidence synthesis largely low/middle-income contexts; local effects vary. No Human Literacy effectiveness claim.

claims.claim: Humans have walked on the Moon.
claims.limit: Apollo 11 historical record; no precise first-step timezone claim.

claims.claim: Communications infrastructure connects people across oceans.
claims.limit: Does not imply everyone is connected.

claims.claim: Disease prevention through vaccination is established.
claims.limit: Letter uses qualitative prevention claim; no exact model-based lives-saved total.
